snippet.title: KILLA - Official Cinematic Gameplay Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: Don't miss the Cinematic Gameplay Trailer for KILLA, a 3D psychological horror adventure mystery game developed by Black Tangerine. Players will embody a young woman consumed by revenge set on a path to reach the killer of her mentor. Engage in conversation across a stylized world in KILLA, coming soon to PC (Steam).
